quality: Native WebGPU; MSAA 1; batched renderer; full authored lighting coverage; moving camera/lights; normal engine.run scheduler; CPU/resource diagnostics enabled; GPU timestamp query disabled; no per-frame fence or readback
startupBoundary: Fresh profile/navigation through scene initialization and two actual submitted frames with GPU completion to readiness; every loading frame retained. Interactive pacing starts at readiness without further queue waits. OS/driver caches are not cleared.

warmupBoundary.selection: fixed before capture; all startup/warmup frames retained

cohortPlan.order: round 1 listed workloads/browsers; round 2 reversed workloads/browsers

measurement: Visible canvas engine rAF cadence and CPU update-to-submit wall time; not physical scanout timing or GPU duration. Canvas screenshot and native browser identity corroborate presentation.
scope: Current B4 on this device; representative F0-F5 plus F8 load envelope. Not A0 comparison, complete G09, sustained-resource qualification or clean-runner release promotion.
rationale: 60 Hz ordinary-play target: P95 near one refresh, P99 no more than two refreshes, over-50 ms frames at most 1% and no three consecutive stalls. F8 keeps identical reported targets but is a stress envelope rather than an ordinary-play promise.
